title: The Alliance at the Alchemist Association
summary: The capital's powers agree to meet at the neutral Alchemist Association, and Hai Bodong warns that the Pill King Gu He could bring many strong men to the Misty Cloud Sect. On the way, Xiao Yan backs Xue Mei against Elder Fu Yan over a Snake Scale Ice Fire Fruit and stops Fu Yan's attack until Chairman Fa Ma steps in. At the meeting Xiao Yan asks every power to choose a side. Yao Lao shows himself as his master, and Fa Ma recognises him as the man who once guided him. The Alchemist Association, the Mu Clan, the imperial family and the Nalan Clan all join him. Ya Fei then reports that Yun Shan will marry Yun Yun to Gu He in two days, and Gu He visits the sealed Yun Yun, who refuses him. The alliance sets the attack for the wedding day.
